verdicts.explanation: The /about page declares Organization structured data but its sameAs list is empty, and the homepage has no JSON-LD at all, so no crawled page links the NPR entity to an external profile.
6 unnamed controls out of 521 is a small fraction (about 1%) of the interactive surface of a homepage that itself carries 336 internal links, so the impact is limited rather than pervasive.

site_specific: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage naming NPR as the publisher entity.
Include a sameAs array on that Organization block linking to NPR's Wikipedia page and its verified social profiles, so assistants can disambiguate NPR from similarly named brands.
Find the 6 icon-only controls on the homepage (likely share, menu or search toggles) that expose no text, aria-label or title.
Add an aria-label describing each control's action, then re-run an accessibility scan to confirm none remain unnamed.
